text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
(So... ex... hausting...!
I-I can't. No more. It's over. Over—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Goooo, Helios!!
Win this and make a miracle happen~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I can't do this.
This is just—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Near the end, my head was just completely filled with...
'I gotta win this for everyone!!'"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My vibes didn't
go up at all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
At a party like this! At a festival like this!
Doing it *only* 'for someone else'... is way too exhausting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Ruby and the others
have been doing this the whole time, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
That's why I've already figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—You and I have
completely different ways of seeing the world.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I pulled off a miracle.
It's amazing...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. That person is, without a doubt...
beyond comprehension.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Will I be able to run like Helios again...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because... I still haven't repaid everyone
for everything they've done for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to make another miracle happen too,
and run for everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Because I'm the one who's the Miracle!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You can do it.
If it's you... I know you can run again.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I must crawl out of the darkness too.
And from here, achieve the ultimate brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, a result worthy of our family name.
For everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Shall we make... another promise?
This time—from me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So that's why Milady...
cracks up laughing at "that," huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Btw, is Ruby actually cracking a huge smile!?
Whoa, amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Palmer-chin,
the lady's smile is super cute, isn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
It made my heart go totally thump... thump...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo smiled.
My heart totally skipped a beat. But...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She's not like me.
Ojo doesn't laugh like I do...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll smile.
I'll laugh just like Helios does. I promise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "I'll give it my all for that, I know I can! Because Helios and I are besties forever!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
'Cause we're besties forever, aren't we?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You two really were
besties for life all along, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
It's been like that right from the start, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Palmer-chin is my bestie for life!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Look, they're calling for you!
What's a party animal supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta make some noise, right?!!
—'Cause this is our party!"
